tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the documents & declarations mentioned in the bid document are compulsory & documents have to be uploaded along with bids online.
All conditions mentioned in bid document are applicable to bidders.
The Technical Evaluation will be made as per the bid document conditions.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Client base: The bidder should have served for minimum 2 clients of Government organizations/PSU as a Security service provider in the past 3 financial years.

The bidder should submit a valid Form C certificate issued by the Department of Labour and an active PSARA License issued under the Private Security Agencies Regulation Act 2005. Firms that fail to submit both the above documents are not eligible.

Size of Security Workforce The bidder shall have a proven track record of providing security services with minimum strength of 10 security staff each year in Government organizations PSU for the last three financial years 2023-24 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 Fractional period service during particular FY will not be considered.
Turnover: The bidder should have turnover of Minimum INR 50 Lakhs per annum during the preceding three financial years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience The bidder should have at least 03 Three Years experience in providing Security Services to Government organizations PSUs Service covering entire FY will only be considered
ISO Certification: The bidder having ISO Certification valid as on last date of submission of bids.
